name: water-ripple
title: Water Ripple
description: Interactive water ripple effect on images. Creates realistic ripple distortions that follow pointer movement with expanding wave animations.

usage.label: React

props.name: src
props.description: The image source URL to apply the water ripple effect to.

props.name: brush-size
props.description: Size of the ripple brush in pixels. Larger values create bigger ripples.
